name: Yarrow Bioscience Inc. Common Stock
summary: Yarrow Bioscience is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing transformative therapies for autoimmune thyroid diseases. The Company's lead product candidate, YB-101, is a potential first-in-class anti-thyroid stimulating hormone receptor (TSHR) monoclonal antibody designed to directly and rapidly disrupt the central mechanism of both Graves' disease (GD) and thyroid eye disease (TED).
